request.note: While adding full D-pad support to Tetris, reproduced that portable client consumed only left-stick axes and South: D-pad, Start and Select were ignored. Implemented D-pad-priority axes, Start start/pause/resume, Select retry, and backward-compatible Game::gamepad_input using the same backend/focus/accumulator. Added axis and game-command regression tests. Also added Game::default_fullscreen so the requested minimal 12x24 board can launch as a tight portrait window; saved preferences and explicit flags win. Native hardware still needs physical confirmation.
